name: io.github.Algiras/agentum-entity-resolver
description: Supplier onboarding checks: company registry, EU VAT and sanctions, with MCP and REST.

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description:
Resolves a company to its official registry record: legal name, registration number, status, legal form, LEI, VAT.
Use when onboarding a vendor, verifying a counterparty on an invoice, or enriching a company name or domain with registry IDs.
Inputs: query (name, domain or registration number); optional jurisdiction (ISO-2), verifyVat, checkSanctions.
Returns: resolved, confidence, entity, candidates, compliance, vatVerification.
Sources: official registries (GLEIF, SEC EDGAR, Companies House, EU registers). Same input → same output. $0.005 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

query.description: Company name, domain, or registration number (LEI, CIK, EIN, UK Company No, Swiss UID, ABN/ACN, UEN, JAR, VAT)

jurisdiction.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. GB, CH, AU, SG, US, LT, DE) or auto-detected

verifyVat.description: Verify EU VAT number against live VIES if available

includeParent.description: Include parent and ultimate parent LEI relationships

checkSanctions.description: Cross-screen entity against OFAC SDN, EU FSF, UN SC and UK FCDO sanctions lists (default true)

includeOfficers.description: Include corporate directors, executives, and officers when available

includeBeneficialOwners.description: Include current beneficial owners (e.g. UK Persons with Significant Control) when available

includeCompanyEvents.description: Include recent official company notices where available (France BODACC); dated evidence, not a current-status or ownership verdict

allowPaidSources.description: Allow fallback to commercial paid aggregators when official registries are paywalled or unavailable

tools.name: verify_eu_vat
tools.description:
Validates an EU VAT number against the European Commission VIES service and returns the registered name and address.
Use when validating the VAT ID on a supplier invoice, applying reverse charge on a cross-border B2B sale, or confirming a vendor's VAT registration at onboarding.
Inputs: vatNumber with 2-letter country prefix (e.g. DE129274202).
Returns: valid, countryCode, vatNumber, registeredName, registeredAddress, checkedAt, source (EU_VIES, CACHE, SYNTAX_ONLY), linkedEntity.
Source: EU VIES live. Same input → same output. $0.005 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number including 2-letter country prefix (e.g. 'LT100004278519')

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description:
Screens a company or person against OFAC SDN, EU, UN and UK FCDO sanctions lists with exact and fuzzy matching.
Use when screening a counterparty before paying, checking a new vendor or customer for sanctions exposure, or re-screening a payee after a detail change.
Inputs: name; optional country (ISO-2), registrationNumber, threshold (default 0.75).
Returns: sanctioned, riskLevel (CLEAR/POTENTIAL_MATCH/EXACT_MATCH/UNKNOWN), matchScore, matchedLists, matches[].
Sources: OFAC/EU/UN/UK lists refreshed every 6h. Same input → same output. $0.005 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

name.description: Entity or individual name to screen

registrationNumber.description: Optional company registration, LEI, or tax ID

tools.name: check_vendor
tools.description:
One-call vendor KYB: registry lookup, EU VAT check and OFAC/EU/UN/UK sanctions screening with a verdict.
Use when onboarding a supplier, approving a vendor before first payment, or re-checking a counterparty.
Inputs: name; optional country (ISO-2), vatNumber, registrationNumber, domain.
Returns: verdict (APPROVED/FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW/REJECTED), riskLevel, sanctionsHit, vatValid, entity, auditTrail[].
Sources: official registries (GLEIF, Companies House); EU VIES live; OFAC/EU/UN/UK lists refreshed every 6h. Same input → same output. $0.010 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

name.description: Legal or trade name of the vendor/counterparty

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number with 2-letter country prefix (e.g. 'DE129274202')

registrationNumber.description: National registration number (CRN, UID, ABN, UEN, CIK, or LEI)

tools.name: verify_bank_payee
tools.description:
Validates an IBAN (ISO 13616 format, length, MOD-97 checksum) and checks the account country matches the expected payee country.
Use when validating bank details on an invoice, confirming a payee's account change before paying, or checking for invoice redirection.
Inputs: iban; optional expectedCountry (ISO-2), payeeName, payeeTaxId (for ownership lookup in public registers).
Returns: valid, countryCode, checksumValid, countryMatch, ownershipVerified, issues[].
Sources: ISO 13616 rules; public registers. Same input → same output. $0.003 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

iban.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN), spaces permitted

expectedCountry.description: Expected 2-letter ISO country code of the payee/vendor (e.g. 'DE')

payeeName.description: Optional legal payee name to cross-check against bank account jurisdiction

payeeTaxId.description: National tax/business registration number (e.g. Polish NIP or Czech IČO) to verify account ownership against official public registers

tools.name: screen_address
tools.description:
Checks a crypto wallet address (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, Litecoin) against OFAC's listed digital-currency addresses. Exact match on the official list only; not behavioural or cluster risk.
Use when about to pay or send funds to an address, vetting a counterparty wallet, or checking a deposit address.
Inputs: address; optional chain (evm, bitcoin, tron, solana, litecoin, other).
Returns: sanctioned, riskLevel (CLEAR/EXACT_MATCH/UNKNOWN), addressType, matches[], coverage.
Source: OFAC SDN, refreshed every 6h. Same input → same output. $0.002 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

address.description: Wallet address to screen (EVM 0x..., Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, Litecoin or other base58 form)

chain.description: Optional chain hint: evm | bitcoin | tron | solana | litecoin | other. Rejected if it contradicts the address format.

tools.name: batch_resolve
tools.description:
Resolves 1 to 25 companies to official registry records in one call; each item works like resolve_entity.
Use when onboarding a supplier list, enriching a CSV of counterparties with registration numbers and status, or deduplicating a vendor file.
Inputs: items[] of {query (name, domain or registration number), optional country (ISO-2)}.
Returns: total, resolvedCount, unresolvedCount, results[] (query, resolved, entity, confidence).
Sources: official registries (GLEIF, SEC EDGAR, Companies House, EU registers). Same input → same output. $0.025 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

query.description: Company name, domain, or registration number

items.description: List of entities to resolve (1 to 25 items)
